kids.name: value-2
kids.chars: By session permission, never the role name; the server refuses regardless (L606-607). The T2 forms: the source group (board 45), a running rebuild (43), Save beside Apply for this session (45; board 08's 200 % inset), the default and "(this session)" (45); offline (53). The role legs (the source group and its window field, Save, Save as default for BTCUSDT) sit in CMP-079 RbacGate (§6.5 L607; A-38 L890); every leg is held here (§1.4; OQ-1).

The title row's [x] (CMP-043 close): its place in the Tab cycle is not in §6.1 L489-491 (gap).

kids.name: value-06
kids.chars: Comfortable (`16` §3 L114; E11-D02 D6): 12 field wells 32 px, words type.ui.body, values type.num.base, the gaps a step up (space.3, 12 px). `16` §3 rule 1 (L125) steps spacing only: the owner settles the type (deviations).

kids.chars: No scrim: §6.1 names none; the chart stays legible while settings apply live (L479-481).

kids.name: value-08
kids.chars: Position: 32 px from the panel's left edge, centred vertically (a judgement: §6.1 gives no offset).

kids.name: value-09
kids.chars: Zoom and text scale (L482-488): the dialog fills the viewport only where 800 px does not fit; here 200 % leaves 1280 × 720 CSS px, so the two columns stay and the body scrolls under the sticky title and footer (derived from L479 and L482); the 200 % and 125–150 % reflow at 1280 × 800 is board 08's inset (L482-488).

kids.name: value-10
kids.chars: Non-colour carriers (§8.3 L771): every state here is words, marks, glyphs and the focus ring: [FP], Chart and auto pressed by a check glyph on the selected fill (E11-D02 D8; E11-D04 D1), the cluster's › named "Latest"; each side colour beside its side name and the B / A letters option (L494-495); hi-fi colour and forced-colors: E18-D03 (§16 L935).
